summary: A three-channel groovebox with drums, a Polivoks-style duophonic synth and a dub siren, each with its own sequencer, effects and mixer channel.
features: Drums: ten Elka Drummer One samples, sine sub, 16 to 64 steps
Step edits with swing, chance and slide; seven factory reggae and funk patterns
PLVKS: two-oscillator duophonic voice with arpeggiator and note sequencer
Dub siren with pitch sweep, filter and glide
Per-channel pan, saturation and tape; two tempo-synced BBD-style echoes
Built on Dinghy; MIDI over USB and TRS, USB audio
